issue.title: Regression with 3.0.0rc1: reading zarr with tensorstore

summary.text: A test reproducing the tensorstore failure (extra "checksum" member in the v2 compressor metadata) fails before the fix and passes after it, with no regressions found and the fix lines covered. However, the guard stage found the fix not guarded and mutation testing did not reach the L2 threshold, so the next step is to strengthen the tests so they catch mutations of the fixed code.

survivors.original: if codec_config["id"] == "zstd" and not codec_config.get("checksum", False):
survivors.replacement: if codec_config["id"] == "zstd" or not codec_config.get("checksum", False):
survivors.description: Uses 'or' so checksum is popped for any codec lacking a truthy checksum.
survivors.diff:
--- a/src/zarr/core/metadata/v2.py
+++ b/src/zarr/core/metadata/v2.py
@@ -121,3 +121,3 @@
                 # Hotfix for https://github.com/zarr-developers/zarr-python/issues/2647
-                if codec_config["id"] == "zstd" and not codec_config.get("checksum", False):
+                if codec_config["id"] == "zstd" or not codec_config.get("checksum", False):
                     codec_config.pop("checksum", None)
